In detail

Sources genuinely disagree here and both are disclosed rather than one being picked. The 2022 police breakdown grouped Bieńczyce with Mistrzejowice and Wzgórza Krzesławickie as one of the lowest-crime pairings citywide on raw counts (just 1 sexual offence and 377 total thefts combined). But the independent 2020 Otodom resident-perception survey rated Bieńczyce individually at only 3.32/5, in the lower bracket of districts surveyed — likely reflecting the area's Soviet-era mass-housing-block reputation more than documented crime, since the raw police figures for the grouping are genuinely low. Sources checked: Portal Samorządowy (2022 police district data); Otodom District Ranking 2020.
